name: How to Rotate PDF Pages
description: Rotate pages in a PDF by 90°, 180° or 270° — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Select pages and rotation
step.text: Choose which pages to rotate (all or specific pages) and the rotation angle: 90°, 180° or 270°.

step.name: Download the rotated PDF
step.text: Click 'Rotate PDF'. Your corrected document is ready to download instantly.
